item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Leela's two overhead tanks. Tank P is tall and narrow; Tank Q is short and wide and holds more water in total. In both tanks the water surface is 3.0 m above an identical ground-floor tap.

Both taps are opened fully. Which claim about the water pressure at the taps is correct?

options.A: Both taps have equal pressure, because the height of water above each tap is the same.
options.B: The tap from tank Q has greater pressure, because tank Q holds more water in total.
options.C: The tap from tank P has greater pressure, because a narrower tank always gives greater pressure.
options.D: Both taps have equal pressure only if the tanks hold equal amounts of water.
